key_insight: Arend supports constructive mathematics in univalent foundations through a homotopy type theory variant with cubical syntax close to Martin-Löf Type Theory.
engineering_relevance: Flexible definition hierarchies and IntelliJ IDEA integration help engineers organize and develop machine-checked mathematical formalizations.
method: Combine cubical syntax with a type theory close to MLTT, retaining selected computational properties.
Support subsumptive subtyping, partial implementations and anonymous extensions through classes and records.
Provide IDE tooling through the IntelliJ Arend plugin.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports arend-lib formalizations in constructive algebra, topology and synthetic homotopy theory, but provides no quantitative evaluation.
watch_item: Arend is not a fully computational cubical type theory; check which computational properties a target formalization requires.
